article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article45Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts
By the assured to recover premia paid under a policy voidable at the election of the insurers.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the insurers elect to avoid the policy.
